phrases.english: 1.O God, be kind to me through the survival of my children,
2.setting them right for me, and allowing me to enjoy them!
3.My God, make long their lives for me,
4.increase their terms,
5.bring up the smallest for me,
6.strengthen the weakest for me,
7.rectify for me their bodies, their religious dedication, and their moral traits,
8.make them well in their souls, their limbs,

phrases.arabic: وَفِي كُلِّ مَا عُنِيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 9.and everything that concerns me of their affair,
10.and pour out for me and upon my hand their provisions!
11.Make them pious, fearing, insightful, hearing,
12.and obedient toward You, loving and well-disposed toward Your friends,
13.and stubbornly resistant and full of hate toward all Your enemies! Amen!
14.O God, through them strengthen my arm,

phrases.arabic: وَأَقِمْ بِهِمْ أَوَدِيْ، وَكَثِّرْ بِهِمْ عَدَدِي،
phrases.english: 15.straighten my burdened back, multiply my number,

phrases.arabic: وَزَيِّنْ بِهِمْ مَحْضَرِي، وَأَحْييِ بِهِمْ ذِكْرِي،
phrases.english: 16.adorn my presence, keep alive my mention,

phrases.arabic: وَاكْفِنِي بِهِمْ  فِي غَيْبَتِي وَأَعِنِّي بِهِمْ عَلَى حَاجَتِي،
phrases.english: 17.suffice me when I am away, help me in my needs,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِي مُحِبِّينَ، وَعَلَيَّ حَدِبِينَ مُقْبِلِينَ مُسْتَقِيمِينَ لِيْ،
phrases.english: 18.and make them loving toward me, affectionate, approaching, upright,
19.obedient, never disobedient,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ عَاقِّينَ وَلا مُخَالِفِينَ وَلاَ خـاطِئِينَ،
phrases.english: 20.disrespectful, opposed, or offenders!
21.Help me in their upbringing, their education, and my devotion toward them,

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ مَعَهُمْ أَوْلاداً ذُكُوراً ،
phrases.english: 22.give me among them from Yourself male children,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ خَيْراً لي وَاجْعَلْهُمْ  لِي عَوناً عَلَى مَا سَأَلْتُكَ،
phrases.english: 23.make that a good for me, and make them a help for me in that which I ask from You!
24.Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan,
25.for You hast created us, commanded us, and prohibited us, and made us desire

phrases.arabic: فِي ثَوَابِ ما أَمَرْتَنَا وَرَهَّبْتَنَا عِقَابَهُ،
phrases.english: 26.the reward of what You hast commanded, and fear its punishment!
27.You assigned to us an enemy who schemes against us,

phrases.arabic: سَلَّطْتَهُ مِنَّا عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلِّطْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ،
phrases.english: 28.gave him an authority over us in a way that You didst not give us authority over him
29.allowed him to dwell in our breasts and let him run in our blood vessels;

phrases.arabic: لاَ يَغْفُلُ إنْ  غَفَلْنَا، وَلاَ يَنْسَى إنْ نَسِينَا،
phrases.english: 30.he is not heedless, though we be heedless, he does not forget, though we forget;
31.he makes us feel secure from Your punishment and fills us with fear toward other than You.
32.If we are about to commit an indecency, he gives us courage to do so,

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ هَمَمْنَا بِعَمَل صَالِح ثَبَّطَنَا عَنْهُ،
phrases.english: 33.and if we are about to perform a righteous work, he holds us back from it.

phrases.arabic: يَتَعَرَّضُ لَنَا بِالشَّهَوَاتِ، وَيَنْصِبُ لَنَا بِالشَّبُهَاتِ،
phrases.english: 34.He opposes us through passions, and sets up for us doubts.

phrases.arabic: إنْ وَعَدَنَا كَذَبَنَا وَإنْ مَنَّانا، أَخْلَفَنَا
phrases.english: 35.If he promises us, he lies, and if he raises our hopes, he fails to fulfil them.
36.If You dost not turn his trickery away from us, he will misguide us,
37.and if You dost not protect us from his corruption, he will cause us to slip.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَاقْهَرْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا بِسُلْطَانِكَ حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنَّا
phrases.english: 38.O God, so defeat his authority over us through Your authority, such that You holdest him back from us

phrases.arabic: بِكَثْرَةِ الدُّعَاءِ لَكَ، فَنُصْبحَ مِنْ كَيْدِهِ فِي الْمَعْصُومِينَ بِكَ.
phrases.english: 39.through the frequency of our supplication to You and we leave his trickery and rise up among those preserved by You from sin!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كُلَّ سُؤْلِي، وَاقْضِ لِي حَوَائِجِي،
phrases.english: 40.O God, grant me my every request, accomplish for me my needs,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَمْنَعْنِي الإجَابَةَ وَقَدْ ضَمِنْتَهَا لِي،
phrases.english: 41.withhold not from me Your response when You hast made Yourself accountable for it to me,

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَحْجُبْ دُعَائِي عَنْكَ وَقَدْ أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ،
phrases.english: 42.veil not my supplication from Yourself, when You hast commanded me to make it,
43.and be kind to me through everything that will set me right

phrases.arabic: فِيْ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي مَا ذَكَرْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَـا نَسِيتُ،
phrases.english: 44.in this world and the next, in everything that I remember or forget,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ أَظْهَـرتُ أَوْ أَخْفَيْتُ، أَوْ أَعْلَنْتُ أَوْ أَسْرَرْتُ،
phrases.english: 45.display or conceal, make public or keep secret!

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي جَمِيعِ ذلِكَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ بِسُؤَالِي إيَّـاكَ،
phrases.english: 46.In all of this, place me through my asking You among those who set things right,
47.those who are answered favourably when they request from You
48.and from whom is not withheld when they put their trust in You,

phrases.arabic: الْمُعَوَّدِينَ بِالتَّعَوُّذِ بِكَ، الرَّابِحِينَ فِي التِّجَارَةِ عَلَيْـكَ، الْمُجَارِيْنَ بِعِـزِّكَ،
phrases.english: 49.those accustomed to seek refuge in You, those who profit through commerce with You, those granted sanctuary through Your might,
50.those given lawful provision in plenty
51.from Your boundless bounty through Your munificence and generosity,

phrases.arabic: الْمُعَزِّينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ بِكَ، وَالْمُجَارِينَ مِن الظُّلْمِ بِعَدْلِكَ،
phrases.english: 52.those who reach exaltation after abasement through You, those granted sanctuary from wrong through Your justice,

phrases.arabic: وَالْمُعَافَيْنَ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَالْمُغْنَيْنَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ بِغِنَاكَ،
phrases.english: 53.those released from affliction through Your mercy, those delivered from need after poverty through Your riches,

phrases.arabic: وَالْمَعْصومِينَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالزَّلَلِ وَالْخَطَأِ بِتَقْوَاكَ،
phrases.english: 54.those preserved from sins, slips, and offenses through reverential fear toward You,
55.those successful in goodness, right conduct, and propriety through obeying You,
56.those walled off from sins through Your power,

phrases.arabic: التَّـارِكِينَ لِكُلِّ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، السَّاكِنِينَ فِي جِوَارِكَ.
phrases.english: 57.the refrainers from every act of disobedience toward You, the dwellers in Your neighbourhood!
58.O God, give me all of that through Your bestowal of success
59.and Your mercy, grant us refuge from the chastisement of the burning,
60.and give to all the Muslims, male and female,

phrases.arabic: وَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِثْلَ الَّذِي سَأَلْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي
phrases.english: 61.and all the faithful, male and female, the like of what I have asked for myself

phrases.arabic: وَلِوُلْدِي فِي عَاجِلِ الدُّنْيَا وَآجِلِ الآخِرَةِ،
phrases.english: 62.and my children, in the immediate of this world and the deferred of the next!
63.Verily You art the Near, the Responder, the All-hearing, the All-knowing,
64.the Pardoner, the Forgiving, the Clement, the Merciful!

phrases.arabic: وَآتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
phrases.english: 65.And "give to us in this world good, and in the next world good, and protect us from the chastisement of the Fire" (2:201)!
